home.audio_hint_text: Background music will start after your first click on this page (browser policy). Click anywhere to start.
home.hero_desc: A complete Arabic learning platform: competitive & cooperative games, self-practice, rich study materials, and a question bank ready to import 140 questions.
home.feat_modes_desc: Competitive, cooperative, endless, and practice — each mode is designed for a different learning goal.
home.feat_reports_desc: Copy the daily report into ChatGPT or Meta AI and get ready-made analysis.
home.feat_practice_desc: Students practice freely, seeing the correct answer and its explanation instantly.
home.feat_bank_desc: Ready-to-use Excel template in TOAFL standard, with an AI assistant to generate questions.
home.feat_audio_desc: Each teacher can set their own music per page, with instant mute.
home.feat_themes_desc: 8 different colors to customize the dashboard — without affecting student pages.
home.cta_ready_desc: Create your first class, add students with PINs, and start your first game in 2 minutes.

login_teacher.desc_sign_in: Enter your email and password to access the dashboard.
login_teacher.desc_forgot: Enter your email, and we'll send you a reset link.
login_teacher.success_reset: Reset link has been sent to your email. Check your inbox or spam folder.
login_teacher.register_desc: Click the button below to contact the admin via WhatsApp.
login_teacher.register_note: A ready message will open — fill in your name, email, and (optionally) your desired password.
login_teacher.register_footer: Self-registration is disabled. All accounts are created by the admin.
